planets.name: TOI-4602 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4602 with a 3.98-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-4602 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4602. Its orbit and size follow Di Maio et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
